For PED-772313, two separate e2e_ids each paid the full 376.03, totaling more than twice the order amount, so this one is overpaid with both payment IDs recorded. I'm now verifying PED-302414, where two distinct e2e_ids both match the exact order amount of 832.46 at the same timestamp, suggesting a duplicate payment scenario to resolve.

PED-931015 is a straightforward exact match—the single linked payment hits the order amount before expiry, so it's cleanly marked paid. I'm now cross-checking every unique e2e_id against their corresponding order IDs to make sure nothing's double-counted or missing from my final mapping, working through the list systematically.

With all 19 e2e_ids accounted for and exactly 2 orphans identified (E3005643910018 and E2649653740019), I want to go back and confirm PED-64007 and PED-91592 genuinely have no payments linked before finalizing.
